name: PokeNyan
source:
The wreckage was found at the site of Violet's house after a fire accident. The shape is very similar to PokeTen.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character7.html]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]It was created by Oscar using data and materials provided by Black Trader, which were actually stolen from Tsukasa. Despite originally designed for conversing with animals, it produced unexpected effects, such as Nelson's ability to speak human language and the extraordinary power of Tesla and Nine.[/spoiler]
